platform.title: Platform
platform.subtitle: CJsmartOps is a single SaaS platform that integrates telemetry agents, containment engines and semantic analysis to deliver real-time operational visibility.

what.title: What is CJsmartOps
what.body: A unified platform combining six integrated capabilities: runtime threat detection, process telemetry, multi-agent orchestration, semantic intelligence, cryptographic custody and forensic auditing. It is not a traditional SIEM or conventional EDR — it is a contextual observability layer designed for cloud-native environments.

how.title: How It Works
how.body: Agents collect process-level telemetry. Receivers normalize and route signals. The correlation engine detects patterns. CIPHER applies semantic intelligence. The dashboard presents everything in a unified view.

products.title: Capabilities
products.subtitle: CJsmartOps is a single platform. These are its six integrated capabilities, each designed to solve a specific aspect of runtime observability, containment and governance.
products.overview_subtitle: Each capability is designed to operate independently and correlate with the others within the platform.

technology.title: Technology
technology.subtitle: The technical foundations that enable contextual observability, trust governance and operational intelligence.

observability.title: Contextual Observability
observability.body: Unlike traditional metric-based monitoring, contextual observability captures the full runtime state: memory, process tree, network flows and filesystem interactions. This enables answering not just 'what happened' but 'why it happened'.

zero_trust.title: Zero Trust & Trust Governance
zero_trust.body: Trust is neither binary nor permanent. Our adaptive scoring model continuously evaluates each process's behavior. Scores decay toward neutrality and require sustained positive evidence to remain high.

telemetry.title: Semantic Telemetry
telemetry.body: CIPHER transforms raw logs into actionable intelligence. It classifies network flows with anomaly detectors, maps relationships between processes and endpoints, and assigns contextual reputation scores to each connection.

intelligence.title: Contextual Intelligence
intelligence.body: Longitudinal analysis over weeks of data enables establishing statistical baselines with high confidence. Drift detection identifies early deviations that static thresholds would miss.

custody.title: Cryptographic Custody
custody.body: All secrets, tokens and sensitive data are encrypted with robust cryptographic standards. Keys rotate periodically. No secrets are stored in plaintext or transmitted without encryption.

impact.title: Low Operational Impact
impact.body: Agents with an ultra-light memory footprint. Non-blocking, rate-limited telemetry collection. Designed to run alongside production workloads without interference.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: CJsmartOps is a technology startup founded and led by Carlos Suárez in Argentina. It develops a proprietary SaaS platform for observability, trust governance and operational intelligence for cloud-native infrastructure.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: Make contextual observability accessible for modern infrastructure, reducing operational noise and improving operational transparency.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: Become the reference platform for telemetry-based cloud-native observability, with global recognition for its scientific approach and operational transparency.

approach.title: Approach
approach.body: Applied research. We observe before automating. Every alert includes a complete evidence chain. Decision-making is data-driven, not vendor claims.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.body: Adaptive trust scoring, reversible containment with audit logging, multi-stage source integrity validation, and minimal-footprint agents designed for cloud-native environments.

security.title: Security
security.body: Security is built into the platform architecture from the start. CJsmartOps follows secure development practices, controlled access models, auditability principles, and protection mechanisms designed to safeguard operational integrity and data protection.

origin.title: Origin
origin.body: Founded by Carlos Suárez in Argentina. CJsmartOps is a founder-led startup with cloud infrastructure and an intensive focus on platform research and development.

leadership.title: Leadership
leadership.name: Carlos Javier Suárez
leadership.bio: Computer Systems Technician with academic foundations in Systems Analysis and Programming. He designs, architects, directs and validates the comprehensive development of the CJsmartOps platform, using AI as a development accelerator under the Vibe Coding paradigm. His approach combines deep technical knowledge with modern software construction methodologies, integrating observability, operational security and automation into a cloud-native platform.

team.title: Structure
team.body: CJsmartOps operates as a founder-led startup. Development is accelerated through AI tools, always under human direction, validation and quality control. Platform architecture and technical decisions are the direct responsibility of the founder.
